description: Source code for a realtime timing worker class managing synchronization, timing, and notifications in a radio communication system.

classes.name: realtime_timing_worker
classes.description: Class managing real-time timing, synchronization, and symbol notifications in a radio system.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::realtime_timing_worker
methods.description: Constructor initializing timing worker with configuration and setting system time validation.

methods.description: Starts the timing worker, initializes timing loop, and synchronizes start.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::stop
methods.description: Stops the timing worker and clears notifiers.

methods.name: realtime_timing_worker::timing_loop
methods.description: Main loop running until stop requested, polling timing updates.

methods.description: Performs timing calculations, detects clock jumps, and notifies symbols.
